description: This header file defines utility functions within the Utils namespace for reading properties and file contents, checking file types, searching files recursively, and expanding variables in strings. It is part of a larger project and provides helper functions for file and string operations.

methods.name: readPropertyFromFile
methods.description: Reads a property value from a file, with support for recursive expansion if the value starts with '$'.

methods.name: readFileContent
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a file into a string.

methods.name: isRegularFile
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a regular file.

methods.name: searchFilesRec
methods.description: Recursively searches for files matching patterns, with exclusions and result collection capped at 10 entries.

methods.name: searchFiles
methods.description: Initiates recursive file search with specified depth and exclusions.

methods.name: ExpandPropertiesInString
methods.description: Expands variables in a string by reading their values from a property file.
